label: Field added, removed or moved
hint: Likely a page definition change: a field is missing, added or moved. Check the page in Application Designer.

label: Control moved
hint: A control moved (the same shape appears at an old and a new position). Check the toolbar or page layout change.

label: Label or text change
hint: Label or text changed. Likely a page field label or message catalog change.

label: Control hidden, shown or greyed out
hint: A control appeared, vanished or greyed out. Possibly PeopleCode (display-only or hide/unhide), a security or Business Unit setup difference. Not proof that authorization is right.

label: Grid layout changed
hint: Grid layout changed (column widths or rows). Check for truncated values; the whole grid may have reflowed.

label: Content shifted below a change
hint: One large region is usually content pushed down or sideways by a change above it. Find the first changed row at the top of the region.

label: Colours, fonts or spacing changed
hint: Colours, fonts or spacing changed. Likely a style sheet or branding change, for example a PeopleTools upgrade.

label: Possible dynamic content
hint: Possible dynamic content (date, time, user, ID). Consider an ignore zone.

label: Whole-page change
hint: Whole-page change (theme or branding, or Classic to Fluid or Classic Plus). Consider capturing a new baseline.

label: Different values or defaults
hint: Values or defaults differ. Possibly a configuration or setup table difference (Business Unit, SetID) or different test data. Confirm both captures used the same test scenario.

label: Capture or rendering artifact
hint: Possibly a capture difference (zoom, window size, scrollbar, font rendering), not an application change. Re-capture with the same settings.

label: Visual change
hint: Visual change. Review it and decide Expected, Regression or Noise.
